name: Lazada-UOB Card
highlights: 5% Rebate on Dine, Entertainment & Transport Spend
5% rebates on Dine, Entertainment & Transport spend

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: 1st Supplementary Card free, S$98.10 for subsequent Supplementary Cards

our_takes.our-take: The Lazada-UOB card is best for frequent Lazada and Redmart shoppers seeking rebates on everyday spend. Earn substantial rebates on Lazada & Redmart purchases, plus elevated rates on dining, entertainment and transport. Other spending earns a lower rebate. Ideal card for those who want a simple card for everyday spending and occasional online purchases on Lazada. ShopBack users may find better overall value with alternatives; factor in the annual fee after the first year.
our_takes.good-for:
Lazada shoppers aiming to maximize rebates on online purchases and daily essentials via RedMart.
Consumers who enjoy dining out, entertainment and need a card for transportation expenses.
Value-conscious individuals seeking rewards on diverse spending categories, including dining, entertainment, and transport spend.
our_takes.things-to-note:
High 27.8% interest can accrue if you don't pay in full, increasing debt significantly.
A 3.25% fee applies to foreign transactions, plus 1% if processed overseas by Singapore merchants.
Late payments incur S$100 fees monthly; missing minimums add 3% interest to existing rate.
